title: Grey Tabbies
description: Brings Bedrock's unused Grey Tabby as a variant for adult Cats.
body:
Requires [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures).

## *Can you make real textures?*

Mojang's old grey tabby texture is horrendous (don't tell anyone). You won't notice it while playing, but it still annoys me. If you are an actual texture artist, contact me (find me `@laxla` on the NeoForged discord), and I'll give you all the Modrinth points. thx
